analysis.session_summary: RBNZ dominated the tape: OCR held at 2.75% versus 3.00% forecast sent NZD down 1.391%, dragging NZD/USD -63.3 pips and AUD/NZD +149.2 pips. AUD CPI beat (0.8% vs 0.7%) lifted AUD, while CAD strengthened 0.085% despite an inline BOC hike. The USD had no own catalyst but firmed against JPY and CHF, with USD/JPY closing 158.25. Most legs lacked clear catalysts, signaling flow-driven, headline-sensitive price action ahead of the FOMC.

themes.theme: RBNZ hold repriced NZD sharply lower
themes.evidence: Official Cash Rate printed 2.75% vs 3.00% forecast, triggering NZD/USD -63.3 pips and AUD/NZD +149.2 pips.

themes.theme: Commodity FX gains from idiosyncratic domestic surprises
themes.evidence: AUD CPI beat gave +0.108% impulse; CAD strengthened 0.085% despite inline BOC hike.

themes.theme: Geopolitical headlines failed to drive sustained FX moves
themes.evidence: Iran-related headlines were the nearest item for several legs but were too weak or moved price the other way.

currency_drivers.USD: USD had no own releases but strengthened 0.158% as a broad default long.
currency_drivers.EUR: EUR firmed as early selling was rejected; no own catalyst.
currency_drivers.JPY: JPY attempted an early gain but gave back 94%; no own catalyst.
currency_drivers.GBP: GBP barely moved; UK budget release was muted.
currency_drivers.AUD: AUD gained because monthly CPI beat forecast, +0.108% impulse; RBA Bullock was muted.
currency_drivers.CAD: CAD strengthened 0.085% despite an inline BOC hike; likely a hawkish interpretation.
currency_drivers.CHF: CHF had no own catalyst and traded as a bystander.
currency_drivers.NZD: NZD fell 1.391% on OCR miss and a further 0.220% after press conference.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped in three legs: -20.4 pips early, +33.0 pips into NY morning, then -11.0 pips late for a net +3.8 pips, with no leg clearly attributed to a catalyst.

polarity_reads.read: NZD weakened 1.391% on the miss, implying the market was positioned for a hike and squeezed long NZD on a hold.
Unscored but NZD dropped a further 0.220%, signaling a dovish interpretation despite no forecast to score.
AUD strengthened 0.108% on the beat, suggesting the market was underweight AUD inflation risk.
Inline but CAD still gained 0.085%, indicating the BOC statement was read as hawkish or CAD shorts were squeezed.
GBP impulse was 0.034%, inside the noise floor; no directional signal.
CAD impulse was -0.037%, inside the noise floor; press conference added no new direction.

scenarios.name: Hawkish FOMC follow-through
scenarios.thesis: FOMC retains tightening bias and pushes USD up; high-beta and RBNZ-hit currencies stay pressured.
scenarios.invalidation: Fed signals pause or imminent cuts.

pair_paths.rationale: Room to test the day's range low as EUR lacks its own catalyst.
Hawkish Fed widens rate differentials, extending the last 55-pip up leg.
RBNZ hold leaves NZD vulnerable to additional USD strength.
AUD gives back part of CPI-led gains if USD dominates.

scenarios.name: Dovish Fed / risk-on rebound
scenarios.thesis: FOMC signals end of hikes, risk sentiment improves, USD softens, high-beta and oversold NZD recover.
triggers: Powell emphasizes data dependence and patience
scenarios.invalidation: Fed sounds more hawkish than expected.

pair_paths.rationale: Mirrors prior 33-pip NY morning rebound on USD weakness.
AUD resumes carry demand after CPI; 21-pip leg can extend.
Short-covering after RBNZ overshoot recovers the 24.9-pip rebound leg.
USD softness dominates any risk-on JPY weakness, testing the 26.8-pip down leg.

scenarios.name: Geopolitical risk-off / headline whipsaw
scenarios.thesis: Iran headlines escalate, boosting safe havens CHF/JPY and wobbling high-beta and risky FX.
scenarios.invalidation: Clear de-escalation or no headline follow-through.

pair_paths.rationale: Safe-haven JPY bid; repeat of the 26.8-pip down leg.
CHF strengthens as safe haven, pressuring the 31.4-pip USD/CHF range.
Cross follows CHF strength against EUR, targeting the 33.9-pip range.

risks.why_it_matters: Would extend USD strength and break EUR/USD below 1.1137.
RBNZ press conference was unscored, leaving room for a snap back; AUD/NZD already moved +149.2 pips.
Earlier Iran headlines moved price the other way and could trigger renewed volatility.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: FOMC at 19:00, FOMC Press Conference at 19:30, and US Advance GDP/Core PCE at 13:30 are the next US drivers; ECB decision and press conference at 14:15/14:45 will reprice EUR. Rates path remains key after the RBNZ hold.
